speaker: Doctor
text: Good morning, I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with a chronic cough, weight loss, and generalized weakness; to better understand your condition, have you noticed any night sweats or fever in addition to these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 68-year-old male. The patient reports having a fever, cough, weakness, night sweats, and poor appetite persisting for 6 months. He has lost 7.5 kg (16.5 lb) over this period. No history of breathlessness, nasal discharge, nasal obstruction, palpitations, chest pain, or digestive symptoms. Released from prison 9 months ago after a 2-year sentence.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Tuberculosis (confirmed by B symptoms, significant weight loss, and recent release from prison).
